title: ieee80211: HT Operation update
description:
This MR changes IE 61 parsing to match the specification of 802.11-2020 (9.4.2.56). The changes are the following:
- The IE "HT Information" is renamed to "HT Operation"
- The field "Beacon ID" is renamed to "STBC Beacon"
- The fields "L-SIG TXOP Protection Full Support" "Phased Coexistence Operation (PCO)" and "Phased Coexistence Operation (PCO) Phase" fields are removed
- The "Basic HT-MCS Set" field is "present in Beacon, Probe Response, Mesh Peering Open and Mesh Peering Confirm frames. Otherwise reserved."

Ideally, "Basic HT-MCS Set" should have its own dissect different from the one of "HT Capabilities" but the standard is not clear enough to do so.

Closes #20335

commits_data.message:
ieee80211: update IE 61 to final 802.11n amendment

Update to the dissection of IE 61 following 802.11-2020 (9.4.2.56), which include 802.11n amendment.
The changes are the following:
* The IE "HT Information" is renamed to "HT Operation"
* The field "Beacon ID" is renamed to "STBC Beacon"
* The fields "L-SIG TXOP Protection Full Support", "Phased Coexistence Operation (PCO)" and "Phased Coexistence Operation (PCO) Phase" fields are removed
* The "Basic HT-MCS Set" field is "present in Beacon, Probe Response, Mesh Peering Open and Mesh Peering Confirm frames. Otherwise reserved."
